I understand it’s their “normal language” as my boyfriend calls it, and I’m not trying to be all up in the business or try to have them change their ways, it just makes me feel left out and extremely confused and even a little awkward... I’ve mentioned it to him and he gets defensive and angry, like they’re not going to change to make me more comfortable. I just feel that if the roles were reversed, I would have my family speak to me in a language my boyfriend would understand so he wouldn’t feel left out or like he’s missing something important. Before anyone tells me to simply learn Spanish, first of all, it’s not that easy and second, I am learning Spanish...trying to at least... I feel like I AM the asshole but I don’t want to be...so someone just tell me, am I the asshole?
